result.summary: No critical or major breakage found. The page renders generally correctly; issues are minor and relate to unclear promotional terms, banner decorative artifacts, and truncated address details. Partially visible carousel items and bottom-cut content were treated as expected features.

issues.description: The promotional banner mentions "3 free deliveries for you" with code TALLINN3 and a minimum order of €10, but no minimum-order condition or delivery fee is shown on any of the visible restaurant cards, making it unclear whether the offer is actually applicable to them.
issues.suggestion: Add clear eligibility details to the promo (e.g., participating restaurants, delivery fee requirements, and validity period), and flag cards that do not qualify.

issues.description: The green promotional banner has large, faint overlapping circle shapes in the background that are partially clipped and look like stray decorative artifacts rather than an intentional pattern.
issues.suggestion: Use a cleaner, more intentional background graphic, or remove the overlapping circles so the banner looks uniform.

issues.description: The delivery address is truncated to "Weizenbergi 20, Tallinn" with a dropdown arrow, but the full street/house information and any missing detail (e.g., apartment, floor, entrance) is not shown.
issues.suggestion: Include the complete address details (apartment/floor/entrance) and display the full address in the dropdown when expanded.
